sources.vendors: the outskirts profile's Holtburg rows verbatim (four, and since M6 14 Monyra the Jeweler's, below) in guid, cell, point, stop_cell, stop_point, buys_item_types and buy_price (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.vendors gives the stops and the price rule, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)), Vendor.cs 577-585 @95ef426d), with the 'sells' lists cut to the wares this profile uses (M6 3 F3 adds Cindrue's account-formula wares, each her create-list row, see components) (the loader refuses a ware that is no stock line, gear floor ware or trade note): Archmage Cindrue 2304 sells the scarabs and the Prismatic Taper of the stock, the Wand 2472, the four Mana Charges and the Trade Note (10,000) 2625 the purse lists (her other nine notes are not listed: the sells-equal-the-draft check prices a trade note at ACE's 1.15 only for a purse note) (the Copper Scarab 686, Value 100, 135, and the Silver Scarab 688, Value 250, 338, are her rows in the draft's town half); Thelnoth Cort the Healer 715 the Mana Potion 379 (230); Ecutha the Tailor 719 the Faran Robe with Hood 5851 (68); Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 buys the drops. Oolutanga's Refuge's Mage 22721 and Healer 22725 are the island's shop: TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's, never added as vendors here (D48) M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 (m6-purse; live 2026-11-12: a level 39 mage's main pack stood full of rings, bracelets, necklaces and gems, the sale named each one outside every listed mask and the loot rule then left every corpse for want of a free slot): Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the outskirts profile's fifth Holtburg row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4020, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B40117, Archmage Cindrue's entry hall, point (157.19, 135.298, 66.12), buys_item_types 0x00040808 = Jewelry 0x8 + Gem 0x800 + PromissoryNote 0x40000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 716 (one row: 2056994848, A9B40117, 157.19, 135.298, 66.12, 264200, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-12). Her MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and her MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Novedion the Gem Seller 9423 (outdoors at (124.79, 31.52, 94.01), mask 0x808, MerchandiseMaxValue 25,000) is not listed: Monyra's walk is the one the dat tests confirm (VendorStopConfirmDatTests and ResupplyRouteDatTests walk every vendor of the den's profile, hers among them) and the outskirts, the Burrow and the Lodge list her already. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).
sources.spell_plan: M6 3 p3, from the ladder rung 'cave' (ladder/war-mage.json, spell_level 3-4, element fire; this ground is the rung's alternate) and D41: character levels 22-26 cast Flame Bolt III; character levels 27-31 cast Flame Bolt IV. The crossing levels are SpellPlan.LevelAt (Mage/SpellPlan.cs) over SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase at plan_cast_chance 0.95, read for the rung's levels (the skill a level needs is its power + 43: III 143, IV 193, V 243, VI 293) (level 22 base 175 is III, 26 base 191 is III, 27 base 194 is IV, 31 base 207 is IV); the rows are the Cave profile's M6 14 (D135, the owner, 2026-11-13: the study's bands, the Cave 21-24, whose alternate this is): the III row starts at 21 with the rung's band (21 base 169 is III).
sources.components: the foci formula, as the Temple 40+'s (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas; HuntingGroundDatTests.A_dungeons_components_cover_the_war_lines_formula_at_every_spell_level_its_plan_names pins the foci formula): Flame Bolt III (spell 82): 1 Copper Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper; Flame Bolt IV: 1 Silver Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper. M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: III (spell level 3): Copper Scarab, Red Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman; IV (spell level 4): Silver Scarab, Pink Taper, Hawthorn, Blue Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above.
sources.supplies: M6 3 p3, sized from the rung 'cave' (the same rung and spell levels as tusker-cave.json, so the same lines): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 224 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 5.6 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1254 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt IV as the worst case, 3 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 3763 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 650 = 10 minutes of that burn rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 210 (a third of the keep), stop_under 4 (a cast needs 3). Copper Scarab 686 (135) and Silver Scarab 688 (338), both Cindrue's: keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to V unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v), so 20 scarabs last 3.2 hours at 1254 casts an hour). The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 30,110 pyreals at the vendors' prices; purse: coin 31,000 (that rounded up to 1,000), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' (a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components)
